guides.concept: 定向鑽掘的姿態積分、誤差來源與障礙淨距。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Directional-drilling attitude integration, error sources and obstacle clearance. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 假想檢核 1：鑽桿長度與垂向投影；verticalChange=L*sin(inclination)=3 m*sin(5 degrees)=0.2615 m
假想檢核 2：方位誤差與橫向漂移；lateralOffset=100 m*tan(0.1 degrees)=0.1745 m
假想檢核 3：曲率半徑與角度單位；radius=arcLength/dTheta=3 m/(0.5*pi/180 rad)=343.8 m
假想檢核 4：工具面與地層轉向反應；observedGain=actualTurn/requestedTurn=0.30 degree/0.50 degree=0.60
假想檢核 5：磁場干擾與方位可信度；headingBias=atan(Btransverse/Breference)=atan(0.5 uT/20 uT)=1.432 degrees

假想檢核 6：陀螺漂移與時間校核；angleDrift=0.02 degree/h*0.5 h=0.010 degree; finalAngleProjection=200 m*tan(0.010 degree)=0.0349 m assuming the final angle applies over the entire length; not a time-integrated guidance path error
CEDD 岩洞指南第二版出版於 2018 年，並非本課的實測報告
FHWA 官方典藏將隧道土木手冊出版日期記為 2009 年
factsEn: Assumed check 1: Rod length and vertical projection; verticalChange=L*sin(inclination)=3 m*sin(5 degrees)=0.2615 m
Assumed check 2: Heading error and lateral drift; lateralOffset=100 m*tan(0.1 degrees)=0.1745 m
Assumed check 3: Curvature radius and angular units; radius=arcLength/dTheta=3 m/(0.5*pi/180 rad)=343.8 m
Assumed check 4: Toolface and ground steering response; observedGain=actualTurn/requestedTurn=0.30 degree/0.50 degree=0.60
Assumed check 5: Magnetic interference and heading confidence; headingBias=atan(Btransverse/Breference)=atan(0.5 uT/20 uT)=1.432 degrees

Assumed check 6: Gyro drift and time checks; angleDrift=0.02 degree/h*0.5 h=0.010 degree; finalAngleProjection=200 m*tan(0.010 degree)=0.0349 m assuming the final angle applies over the entire length; not a time-integrated guidance path error
CEDD issued its second cavern guide in 2018; it is not a measurement report for these examples
The FHWA official archive dates the civil tunnel manual to 2009

Hypothetical receiving shaft (boundary comparison, not a named project)
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出埋深或斷面、地質水文、支護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, ground and groundwater, support system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：水平定向鑽掘導向
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Horizontal directional drilling guidance
guides.concept: 本課以定向鑽掘的姿態積分、誤差來源與障礙淨距為主線，從鑽桿長度與垂向投影與方位誤差與橫向漂移建立系統邊界，再把磁場干擾與方位可信度、設施淨距與不確定度連到竣工閉合與全線可信度。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on directional-drilling attitude integration, error sources and obstacle clearance. It begins with Rod length and vertical projection and Heading error and lateral drift, links Magnetic interference and heading confidence and Utility clearance and uncertainty, and ends with As-built closure and route confidence. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
procedure: 鑽進長度沿實際路徑量取，垂向變化由傾角投影決定而非直接等於桿長。分段積分需保留角度正負與參考方向，彎曲段還需考慮角度在桿內的變化；一個末端傾角不能代表整段平均姿態。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對桿長紀錄、傾角符號與獨立高程閉合；若出現把向下傾角符號反用，路徑深度隨進尺愈算愈錯，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
微小方位偏差沿距離累積成顯著橫向漂移，固定偏差與隨機噪聲的統計行為不同。直線投影可估單一偏差的量級，真正路線需要逐段姿態積分；不能把多次讀值平均當成對磁北或控制網的獨立校核。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較重複方位讀值與獨立測量控制的方向差；若出現固定方位偏差被當隨機誤差平均，長距離後仍偏離走廊，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
相鄰姿態角差與弧長決定局部曲率，但角度需轉成弧度才可直接使用半徑關係。鑽具和成品管各有不同彎曲限制，短距姿態噪聲會製造假小半徑；路徑平滑不能刪除真實局部折角的證據。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比對相鄰姿態、測距及獨立管材彎曲要求；若出現把度數直接當弧度使半徑低估數十倍，導致錯誤判讀，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
工具面方向設定與實際軌跡轉向之間受地層、鑽頭和桿件彈性影響，並非固定一比一。觀察到的轉向增益僅適用該段與該工況，交替地層可能改變幅度和延遲；應先識別回應再談模型是否可信。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照工具面紀錄、實測姿態變化與地層轉換里程；若出現沿用前一土層增益造成過度修正，曲率在界面集中，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
磁導向依賴地磁向量，埋設鋼材、電流及鄰近設施會改變局部場。簡單橫向擾動模型可顯示方位敏感度，但傾角補償與三維磁異常需另評估；總磁場強度接近正常也不能保證方向不偏。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較三軸磁場、設備位置與非磁性導向或測量證據；若出現局部鋼材扭轉磁場方向，總場近正常卻方位已偏移，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
陀螺可避免部分磁干擾，但零偏會隨積分時間累積，溫度和振動又可能改變偏差。恆定漂移假設適合看時間敏感度，不保證實際誤差線性；獨立起始方位與週期校核需連到每段資料的時間戳。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照陀螺溫度、時間戳與獨立方位閉合差；若出現重啟後沿用舊零偏，磁場雖無影響仍產生路線漂移，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
地下設施的中心線位置、外徑和調查精度都影響真正淨距，圖上中心距不是可用安全間隔。不確定度扣減需明示保守或統計規則，還要扣除兩者尺寸；未知設施不能因地圖空白就視為不存在。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐一核對設施實測位置、外徑及定位不確定度；若出現只比較中心線距離而漏扣半徑，使實際外表面互相侵入，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
環空流速由流量和淨流通面積決定，偏心、岩屑床與非牛頓流變會改變局部速度及壓損。平均流速不能單獨證明孔壁穩定或不會冒漿；導向紀錄需與返流及壓力資料共同解釋地層反應。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照進返流量、環空壓力及地表異常位置；若出現岩屑床縮小流路推高局部壓力，但平均環空面積仍被當固定，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
成品管沿孔道曲率彎曲，回拖張力再疊加軸向應變，最外纖維可能成為控制位置。小應變線彈性相加需使用一致材料模量，熱塑管的時間與溫度行為不能直接套鋼材；實際孔徑和摩擦仍影響回拖荷載。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較成孔曲率、回拖荷重及成品管材溫度性能；若出現鋼管模量被錯用於塑膠管，嚴重低估實際軸向變形，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
終點閉合誤差是整段測量的一項約束，不能保證中途每個位置正確；相反方向偏差可能在終點互相抵消。全線成果需保留逐桿原始資料、校正和獨立控制，並把位置不確定度沿路徑呈現。 判別這個機制時，應觀察把終點閉合與中途獨立控制點及逐桿資料比對；若出現中途左右偏差相互抵消，終點漂亮卻曾侵入設施走廊，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
procedureEn: Drilled length follows the actual path, while vertical change comes from inclination projection rather than rod length itself. Segment integration requires signed angles and reference direction, with curvature changing attitude within a rod. One endpoint inclination cannot automatically represent the segment-average attitude. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check rod-length records, inclination signs and independent elevation closure. If reversing the sign of downward inclination progressively corrupts calculated depth, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Small heading bias accumulates into substantial lateral drift, unlike zero-mean random noise. Straight projection estimates one fixed-bias effect, while real routes require segmentwise attitude integration. Averaging repeated readings does not independently verify the magnetic reference or survey control network. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare repeated headings with independently surveyed control directions. If a fixed heading bias is treated as random noise and the long route still leaves its corridor, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Local curvature relates arc length to attitude change, with radians required in the radius relation. Drill string and product pipe have different bending constraints, and short-baseline attitude noise can create falsely tight curvature. Smoothing the path must not erase evidence of a real localized dogleg. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare adjacent attitudes and distances with separately established pipe-bending requirements. If using degrees directly as radians understates radius by a large factor and distorts interpretation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Toolface orientation does not translate one-to-one into route turning because ground, bit and rod elasticity intervene. Observed steering gain belongs to the specific segment and state; changing layers alter magnitude and delay. Identify the response before treating a steering model as transferable. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare toolface records and measured attitude changes against geological transitions. If reusing the previous layer gain overcorrects the route and concentrates curvature at the interface, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Magnetic guidance depends on the field vector, disturbed by buried steel, electrical currents and nearby structures. A simple transverse perturbation illustrates heading sensitivity, while tilt compensation and three-dimensional anomalies require separate assessment. A near-normal field magnitude does not prove an unbiased field direction. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare three-axis magnetic fields and equipment positions with nonmagnetic guidance or survey evidence. If local steel rotates the field while near-normal magnitude conceals heading bias, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

A gyro avoids some magnetic disturbance, but bias accumulates with integration time and can vary with temperature and vibration. Constant drift illustrates time sensitivity without guaranteeing linear real error. Independent initial heading and periodic checks must be linked to each segment timestamp. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare gyro temperature and timestamps with independent heading-closure error. If reusing an old bias after restart creates route drift despite freedom from magnetic interference, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

True utility clearance depends on centerline location, outside dimensions and survey uncertainty; map center distance is not available separation. State conservative or statistical uncertainty rules and subtract both object dimensions. A blank map does not establish that unknown services are absent from the route. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check surveyed utility position, outside diameter and positioning uncertainty individually. If comparing centerlines without radii allows actual external surfaces to intersect, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Annular velocity follows flow and available area, while eccentricity, cuttings beds and non-Newtonian rheology change local speed and loss. Mean velocity alone proves neither wall stability nor freedom from inadvertent returns. Interpret guidance with return-flow and pressure evidence to understand ground response. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare feed and return flow, annular pressure and locations of surface anomalies. If a cuttings bed restricts flow and raises local pressure while nominal annular area is treated as unchanged, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

The product pipe bends along bore curvature while pullback tension adds axial strain, potentially governing the outer fiber. Small-strain elastic addition requires consistent modulus; thermoplastic time and temperature behavior cannot be replaced by steel assumptions. Actual bore geometry and friction also affect pullback loading. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare bore curvature, pullback load and temperature-dependent product-pipe properties. If applying steel modulus to plastic pipe substantially understates actual axial deformation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Endpoint closure constrains the survey but does not prove every intermediate position, because opposing errors can cancel at the end. Preserve raw rod-by-rod data, corrections and independent control. Present uncertainty along the route rather than interpreting one endpoint residual as a universal error bound. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare endpoint closure with intermediate independent control points and rod-by-rod data. If opposing intermediate errors cancel at the endpoint despite entering a utility corridor along the route, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
evidence: 將核對桿長紀錄、傾角符號與獨立高程閉合列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把向下傾角符號反用，路徑深度隨進尺愈算愈錯，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將比較重複方位讀值與獨立測量控制的方向差列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現固定方位偏差被當隨機誤差平均，長距離後仍偏離走廊，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將比對相鄰姿態、測距及獨立管材彎曲要求列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把度數直接當弧度使半徑低估數十倍，導致錯誤判讀，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將對照工具面紀錄、實測姿態變化與地層轉換里程列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現沿用前一土層增益造成過度修正，曲率在界面集中，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將比較三軸磁場、設備位置與非磁性導向或測量證據列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現局部鋼材扭轉磁場方向，總場近正常卻方位已偏移，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
evidenceEn: Apply the following check at handover: Check rod-length records, inclination signs and independent elevation closure. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If reversing the sign of downward inclination progressively corrupts calculated depth, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Compare repeated headings with independently surveyed control directions. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a fixed heading bias is treated as random noise and the long route still leaves its corridor, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Compare adjacent attitudes and distances with separately established pipe-bending requirements. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If using degrees directly as radians understates radius by a large factor and distorts interpretation, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Compare toolface records and measured attitude changes against geological transitions. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If reusing the previous layer gain overcorrects the route and concentrates curvature at the interface, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Compare three-axis magnetic fields and equipment positions with nonmagnetic guidance or survey evidence. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If local steel rotates the field while near-normal magnitude conceals heading bias, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
pitfalls: 把向下傾角符號反用，路徑深度隨進尺愈算愈錯。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對桿長紀錄、傾角符號與獨立高程閉合，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
把度數直接當弧度使半徑低估數十倍，導致錯誤判讀。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比對相鄰姿態、測距及獨立管材彎曲要求，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
局部鋼材扭轉磁場方向，總場近正常卻方位已偏移。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較三軸磁場、設備位置與非磁性導向或測量證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
只比較中心線距離而漏扣半徑，使實際外表面互相侵入。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐一核對設施實測位置、外徑及定位不確定度，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
鋼管模量被錯用於塑膠管，嚴重低估實際軸向變形。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較成孔曲率、回拖荷重及成品管材溫度性能，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
pitfallsEn: Reversing the sign of downward inclination progressively corrupts calculated depth. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check rod-length records, inclination signs and independent elevation closure to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

Using degrees directly as radians understates radius by a large factor and distorts interpretation. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare adjacent attitudes and distances with separately established pipe-bending requirements to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

Local steel rotates the field while near-normal magnitude conceals heading bias. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare three-axis magnetic fields and equipment positions with nonmagnetic guidance or survey evidence to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

Comparing centerlines without radii allows actual external surfaces to intersect. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check surveyed utility position, outside diameter and positioning uncertainty individually to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

Applying steel modulus to plastic pipe substantially understates actual axial deformation. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare bore curvature, pullback load and temperature-dependent product-pipe properties to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

related.title: 豎井沉井施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「鑽桿長度與垂向投影」與「設施淨距與不確定度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；豎井沉井施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Rod length and vertical projection" and "Utility clearance and uncertainty" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Sinking-caisson shaft construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦定向鑽掘的姿態積分、誤差來源與障礙淨距；豎井沉井施工則以沉井下沉平衡、刃腳接觸與封底抗浮為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on directional-drilling attitude integration, error sources and obstacle clearance; Sinking-caisson shaft construction centres on sinking-caisson equilibrium, cutting-edge contact and base-plug uplift, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「鑽桿長度與垂向投影」與「下沉驅動與力系平衡」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到豎井沉井施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「位移速率與突沉辨識」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Rod length and vertical projection” and “Sinking drive and force equilibrium”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Sinking-caisson shaft construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Movement rate and sudden-sinking detection", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 水平定向鑽掘導向
history.text: 本課討論的定向鑽掘的姿態積分、誤差來源與障礙淨距，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。導向幾何與磁場算例為小偏差或單段簡化，並非鑽進路徑指令；定位不確定度、管徑及設施尺寸需另併入。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。FHWA 公開章節區分 HDD、頂管與微型隧道，並說明導向感測與磁場干擾；城市管線走廊為假想場景，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on directional-drilling attitude integration, error sources and obstacle clearance reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Guidance geometry and magnetic examples simplify small errors or single segments and are not drilling commands; positioning uncertainty, pipe diameter and utility dimensions require separate inclusion. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. FHWA distinguishes HDD, pipe jacking and microtunneling and describes guidance sensing and magnetic interference. The urban utility corridor is a hypothetical setting. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
